objective: Verify shape, rank, layout, and type of the future candidate interface.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the kernel signature and indexing expressions.

setup: Inspect the candidate parameter declarations, buffer view type, and index arithmetic (row stride pitch, column bound width, row bound height).
